title: feat(detail): the record header's stage menu asks for the fields a stage needs through the shared fill-in dialog
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuKHcon4EnvxsS8GZmDMLxBs)_

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgWV6ouxRg2fByapa6F

Fixes #35956
(PR 2 of 2. PR 1 #35994, merged `9a98a467`, made the pre-check and the dialog shared and wired the list cell, the record page's inline Save and the kanban drop. This PR moves the last surface, the record header's stage menu, onto them and deletes its own copy. The record drawer's per-field save is #35995, its own card, not in this card's acceptance.)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none. No skill under `skills/` and no page under `content/docs/` describes the stage menu's dialog.
Flow: dev-thread rule (maintainer 2026-11-20 09:22:50Z): the card thread builds itself; L1 by L1-a. The seat's claim names no L2 while Clause-② stays `no`.

## 维护者速读

- 记录页头部的阶段下拉（记录名旁边那个带小箭头的状态标签），现在和列表单元格、记录页行内保存、看板拖动用的是**同一个**补填框，仓库里只剩一份预判和一个框。
- 选一个会让空字段变必填的阶段（例如把项目改成「已完成」，而「完成说明」此时必填）：框里先是记录名，再是「状态：已完成」（只读），下面列出要补的字段。不填点「移动」，字段下面显示「必填」，什么都不写；补填的值又让别的字段变必填时，框里马上追加；填好点「移动」，阶段和补填的值一次写入；点「取消」什么都不写，标签还是原来的阶段。
- 选一个什么都不需要补的阶段：弹出的也是这个框，只有记录名和「状态：X」，焦点在「移动」上，按回车就确认（和原来一样）。
- 服务端仍然拒绝时框不关：说的是框里的字段就显示在它下面；说的是另一个能填的字段就把它加进框里；别人刚改过这条记录，框底提示「已显示最新版本」并重新读取；其他原因（无权限等）在框底用原来的那句话。
- 和以前不同的一点：富文本、文件、公式这类不能就地编辑的字段，以前的阶段菜单不检查字段能不能就地编辑（读代码所得，未实测），现在和其它几处一样不问，直接走服务端的拒绝提示（卡第 6 项）。
- 不变的：记录页里的阶段条（`record:path`）的确认框原样保留。
- 需要你决定的：无。

## What changes

**The stage menu on the shared pair** (`@object-ui/plugin-detail`, `renderers/recordPathStageChange.tsx`, `useStageChange` with `collectFields`, which only `RecordStageMenu` turns on):

- Which fields a pick asks for is now `collectRequiredWhenPromptFields(objectFields, record, { [statusField]: value }, { fillable })` from `@object-ui/fields`, the evaluator PR 1 shared. The menu's own `fieldsNeededAt` loop over `resolveFieldRuleState` is deleted. `fillable` is the question the menu already asked (not the stage field, not read-only, computed or a system field, the reader's `recordEdit` grant), the same one `InlineEditSaveBar` asks.
- The dialog is `RequiredFieldsDialog`. The menu's own field form (`InlineFieldInput` rows, `data-stage-change-field*`), its refusal routing and `confirmWithFields` are deleted. The menu passes the record's name (`getRecordDisplayName`), one change row (the stage field's label and the picked stage's label), `moreFields` for chained requirements, `refusalField` (a field the refusal names that the reader may fill and that has an in-place editor), and its own title, description and `移动` label, which are the strings it used before (`detail.pathStageChangeTitle`, `detail.stageMenuFieldsDescription` / `detail.pathStageChangeDescription`, `detail.pathStageChangeConfirm`). No new string.
- Every pick opens this dialog, including a stage that makes nothing required. It is then the move's confirmation, with no rows to fill. This keeps one dialog and one refusal path: a refusal that names a fillable field adds that field, as the old form did.
- The write is still one `updateVia` with `{ ...typedValues, [statusField]: value }` and `ifMatch` set to the record's `updated_at`, then a re-read. On a rejection, a refusal that names fields goes to the dialog as it came. Every other refusal becomes the menu's own line from `stageRefusalLines`, which is unchanged: a 409 re-reads the record and says so, a permission refusal reads the stage line and never the raw 403, an external source reads the read-only line. That line goes to the dialog's foot. The stage does not move.
- `record:path` (`collectFields` off) keeps its `AlertDialog` confirmation and its refusal under the rail, unchanged.

**The shared dialog, one behaviour** (`@object-ui/fields`, `RequiredFieldsDialog`). When it opens with no field to fill, its submit button takes the focus instead of Radix's first tabbable (Cancel), so Enter confirms the change the reader just picked. This is the #35891 keyboard contract the stage menu's `AlertDialog` carried. With fields, the first field still takes the focus as before. No prop changed. The other hosts open it only with fields, so they see no difference.

## Acceptance notes

The card's acceptance items, as they stand after both PRs:

- List cell, record page inline, kanban drop: PR 1.
- **Header stage switch to the stage that needs B: the dialog opens and B can be filled**: this PR (tests and browser below).
- Chained C: this PR's tests and browser for the stage menu; PR 1 for the other surfaces.
- B already has a value: not asked (the shared collector's stored-value skip, `requiredWhenPrompt.test.ts`). B is rich text: not asked, and the refusal reads in the dialog's foot (test and browser below). The list's 「打开记录」 link was delivered by S1 #35864 (PR 1's item 7).
- A refusal while the dialog is open: it stays and says why (a 409 test here; PR 1 for the other surfaces).
- 375 px: browser below.
- **"Only one pre-check and one dialog remain in the repository"**: `recordPathStageChange.tsx` no longer reads `resolveFieldRuleState`, `isMissingForRequired` or `InlineFieldInput`. Its `fieldsNeededAt` is now one call of the shared collector. `confirmWithFields` and the `data-stage-change-field*` rows are gone; the only remaining mention is the migrated test asserting their absence. `collectRequiredWhenPromptFields` and `RequiredFieldsDialog` are defined only in `ui/packages/fields/src/`.

Readings I chose (seat claim, items 1–3):
1. Every pick from the header menu opens the shared dialog, including a stage that needs nothing. Two dialogs that hand over to each other on a refusal would be the second copy this card removes.
2. A 409 keeps the menu's own line and re-read, the behaviour #35891 shipped. It does not open the record page's conflict-compare dialog: the move is one field the reader can press again on the record as it now stands.
3. The shared collector skips types with no in-place editor (rich text, file, formula). The stage menu therefore stops asking for them and falls through to the server's refusal, as card item 6 says for every surface.

Platform checklist: no clause moves.

## Tests

Migrated: `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RecordStageMenu-35891.test.tsx`. The stage menu's dialog is now `role="dialog"` (the shared `Dialog`), not `alertdialog`, and its rows are `data-required-fields-field` / `data-required-fields-error` instead of `data-stage-change-field*`. The rest is unchanged. One assertion moved: "left empty, the server refusal names the field" now first meets the shared dialog's own presence check ("Required", nothing written). The server refusal under the field is then asserted after a value is typed. The record:path control (`alertdialog`, Cancel focused) is untouched.

New:
- `RecordStageMenu-35891.test.tsx`, `#35956 the stage menu opens the shared fill-in dialog` (7 tests):
  - it is the shared dialog, with the record name and the read-only stage row and no old form;
  - a stage that needs nothing opens the same dialog with no rows;
  - a chained field joins and Move waits for it, then sends one update `{ stage, loss_reason, loss_detail }` with `ifMatch`;
  - control: a required rich-text field is not asked, and its refusal reads at the foot;
  - a 409 keeps the dialog and the typed value, re-reads, and says so at the foot;
  - a permission refusal reads the stage line, not the raw 403;
  - Cancel writes nothing and the next pick starts empty.
- `ui/packages/fields/src/__tests__/RequiredFieldsDialog.inPlace-35956.test.tsx` (2 tests): with nothing to fill, the submit button is focused and submits `{}`; control: with a field, that field is focused.

Ablation (on committed code, each restored with `git checkout --`, `git diff` empty afterwards):
- the dialog's no-field focus branch disabled (`if (true || …) return`) → 2 failed: the new fields test, and the stage menu's "Enter confirms the stage it names". Restored → green.
- the stage menu's `fillable` forced `false` (nothing is ever asked) → 7 failed / 22 in `RecordStageMenu-35891`. Restored → green.
- the field-scoped refusal no longer handed to the dialog as it came (`if (false) throw err`) → 2 failed / 22. Restored → green.
- Seen during ablation, not a defect: `fields={[]}` alone keeps the suite green. The dialog's `moreFields` re-collects against the stored record and finds the same fields. The `fillable` ablation above is the one that removes the asking.

## Verification

<details><summary>Local runs</summary>

- `vitest` from `ui/`, one package at a time, on `5e61f1e9`:
  - `fields`: 316 files, 4748 tests passed (1 file skipped);
  - `plugin-detail`: 396 files, 3643 tests passed (1 skipped);
  - `plugin-kanban` plus `plugin-grid`'s `ObjectGrid.requiredPrompt-35956`: 82 files, 546 tests.

  On `0477e86e` (test-only commit): the two changed files, 29/29.
- `tsc --noEmit` for `@object-ui/plugin-detail` and `@object-ui/fields`: clean. `eslint` on the changed files: 0 errors. The 9 `no-explicit-any` warnings are on lines this PR did not touch.
- Clause-② `no`: no export added, removed or retyped. `RecordStageMenuProps`, `useStageChange`'s signature and `StageChange`, and `RequiredFieldsDialogProps` are unchanged. `StageTarget` is module-private.
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs`: VERDICT clean (main `9a98a467`, 0 open PR heads share a file).
- Changed lines: 6 files, +379 / −217, under the 3000 threshold.

</details>

<details><summary>Browser</summary>

Setup:
- Server: `examples/app-showcase`, `objectstack dev --seed-admin -p 43956` on its own temp DB.
- UI: the `ui/apps/console` Vite dev server over it (workspace sources).
- Browser: headless Chromium, zh-CN; light 1600×1000, dark 1600×1000, light 375×812.
- Probe fields: no shipped object declares `requiredWhen`, so for the run only `showcase_project` gained PR 1's three probe fields (not committed): `completion_note` required on 已完成, `follow_up` required when the note is `partial`, rich-text `cancel_memo` required on 已取消.

Before (main `9a98a467`'s two files restored for the run): on 「Website Relaunch」 (进行中), the tag's menu → 已完成 opens the menu's own form 「更改阶段？ 改为已完成前，请先填写： Completion Note*」. It shows no record name and no change row. Move with the field empty sends `PATCH {"status":"completed"}` → 400 「Completion Note不能为空」, which then shows under the field.

After (light; the same in dark on 「Data Platform」 and at 375 px):
- 已完成 → 「更改阶段？ | 改为已完成前，请先填写： | Website Relaunch | 状态: 已完成 | Completion Note*」. 0 writes. The first field is focused.
- Move empty → 「必填」 under the field. 0 writes.
- Type `partial` → 「Follow-up Owner*」 joins.
- Cancel → 0 writes. The tag still reads 进行中.
- Fill both and press Move → one `PATCH {"completion_note":"partial","follow_up":"ops@example.com","status":"completed"}` with `If-Match` → 200. The tag reads 已完成.
- 进行中 (nothing to fill) → the same dialog with 「将此记录移至进行中？ | Website Relaunch | 状态: 进行中」 and 「移动」 focused. Enter → `PATCH {"status":"active"}` → 200.
- 已取消 (the required field is rich text) → no row. Move → `PATCH {"status":"cancelled"}` → 400. The dialog stays with 「Cancel Memo: Cancel Memo不能为空」 at its foot, and the tag still reads 进行中.
- 375 px: the dialog fits the screen and its buttons stack.

Screenshots and journey logs are with the seat. Not measured: Safari / WebKit (no WebKit build in the container).

</details>
